headline: TDB, NeoSeekermetals join hands to scale critical minerals recovery from e-waste
summary: India's Technology Development Board under the Department of Science and Technology has signed an agreement with Hyderabad-based NeoSeekermetals to recover critical minerals from e-waste.
why: Critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt and rare earths are key inputs for batteries and electronics, so domestic recovery from waste can affect supply security.
